One of the bodies that the last `PhysicsOverlapSphere` or `PhysicsOverlapBox` found.
@param index A number from 0 to the count that the query returned, minus 1.
@returns The entity of the body.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
